outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Chemtech delivered record FY25 revenue (34% YoY) and PAT growth (69%) driven by marquee customer wins (L&T, AMNS) and adoption of patented valves, with India’s multi-lakh crore industrial capex cycle creating a multi-year tailwind; the company’s differentiated, safety-critical valve technologies position it to capture disproportionate share in high-growth sectors like steel and fertilizers.
